## What are you trying to do?

Describe the user workflow and what currently gets in the way.

## Proposed behavior

Explain the smallest useful change, including the affected screen/component.
For UI changes, include phone and tablet/desktop behavior where relevant.

## Scope and alternatives

What existing behavior should be preserved? Would this change stored data,
permissions, native integrations or deployment requirements?

## Contribution

If you would like to work on this, say so. Discuss substantial changes before
opening an implementation PR; see CONTRIBUTING.md.
